Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::deleteProductCatalog(id:Integer): Boolean {
          definition:
          deletedCatalog : ProductCatalog = CurrentStore.ProductCatalog@pre->any(catalog : ProductCatalog | catalog.id = id)
            
            precondition:
          CurrentStore.ProductCatalog->exists(catalog : ProductCatalog | catalog.id = id)
            
            postcondition:
          CurrentStore.ProductCatalog@pre->includes(deletedCatalog) and CurrentStore.ProductCatalog->excludes(deletedCatalog) and result = true
            
        }
